# Northwind Telecom — Activation FAQ

*Synthetic document. Northwind Telecom is a fictional operator invented for testing; every figure
below is made up and describes no real product, tariff or person.*

## How long does activation take?

A new SIM is usually live within four hours of the verification call. The outer limit is 24 hours.
If the SIM is still not live after 24 hours, raise a ticket from the app and it is escalated
automatically.

## What is the verification call?

Regulation requires a short call from 59059 to the new number before it can carry traffic. The call
asks you to confirm your name and the last four digits of the identity document used at sign-up.
The call is attempted three times over two days; if all three are missed the order is cancelled and
any amount paid is refunded in full.

## Which documents are accepted?

Any one government photo identity document plus one proof of the address where the connection will
be used. A digital copy is accepted if it is legible and unexpired. A document in a name other than
the applicant's is not accepted.

## Can I keep my old number?

Yes, through mobile number portability. See the porting guide; the short version is that the new SIM
stays inactive until the porting window opens, and the old connection stops working at that moment.

## Why does my new SIM show no network?

In order of how often it happens: the SIM is not seated properly, the handset has not been restarted
since the SIM was inserted, the APN is wrong on an unlocked imported handset, or the activation has
genuinely not completed. Restart the handset first; it resolves most cases.

## Is there an activation fee?

No. The first pack or the first month's rent is the only amount charged at activation. A physical
SIM delivered to an address carries no delivery charge.

## Can somebody else collect the SIM?

No. The SIM is handed only to the applicant, against the same identity document used at sign-up.
